name: io.github.tonyyang0504/trustpilot-mcp
description: Trustpilot (social): me, read_mentions, reply_comment. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TRUSTPILOT_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Trustpilot API key (Client ID); HTTP Basic username on the refresh request ('Authorization: Basic [BASE64_ENCODED(API_KEY:API_SECRET)]', https://developers.trustpilot.com/authentication).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TRUSTPILOT_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Trustpilot API secret; HTTP Basic password on the refresh request.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TRUSTPILOT_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Business-user refresh token from the authorization-code or password grant. 'Access tokens expire after 100 hours and refresh tokens expire after 30 days'; the runtime mints access tokens from it and keeps a returned new refresh token (PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR persists it).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TRUSTPILOT_BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Business unit id (GET /v1/business-units/find?name=<domain> with the API key).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TRUSTPILOT_BUSINESS_USER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Id of the business user replies are authored by (authorBusinessUserId).
